title: CAS issuances down 27% as UK visa refusals jump 30%, Enroly data shows
summary_en: Recruitment behaviours are changing, with South Asian and African countries the worst hit amid the UK's compliance squeeze, according to new data analysis from Enroly.
author: Beth Kennedy
title_cn: CAS issuances down 27% as UK visa refusals jump 30%, Enroly data shows
